business_summary: Hainan Shennong Seed Industry Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the breeding, production, and sale of hybrid rice seeds in China. The company offers fertilizer; smart agricultural management; primary processing of edible agricultural products; retail of edible agricultural products; comprehensive utilization of fishery processing waste; sales of animal husbandry and fishery feed; wholesale of edible agricultural products; wholesale and retail of aquatic products; marine environmental services; technical services, technical development, technical consultation, technical exchange, technology transfer, and technology promotion; sales of specialized machinery for agriculture, forestry, animal husbandry, sideline production, and fishery; and leisure and sightseeing activities. It also engages in production of main crop seeds; operation of crop seeds; wholesale of pesticides; production of feed; production of food; aquaculture; production of aquatic seedlings; fishing; production of health food; sale of food; import and export of crop seeds; and import and export of aquatic seedlings. The company was formerly Hainan Shennong Technology Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Hainan Shennong Seed Industry Technology Co., Ltd. in July 2024. Hainan Shennong Seed Industry Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2000 and is based in Haikou City, China.
business_summary_ko: Hainan Shennong Seed Industry Technology Co., Ltd.는 중국에서 잡종 벼 종자의 육종, 생산 및 판매에 종사하고 있습니다. 회사는 비료를 제공합니다. 스마트 농업경영; 식용 농산물의 1차 가공; 식용 농산물 소매; 수산가공 폐기물의 종합적 이용; 축산 및 수산 사료 판매; 식용 농산물 도매; 수산물 도매 및 소매; 해양 환경 서비스; 기술 서비스, 기술 개발, 기술 상담, 기술 교류, 기술 이전 및 기술 진흥; 농업, 임업, 목축업, 부업 생산, 어업용 전문 기계 판매; 레저 및 관광 활동. 또한 주요 작물 종자 생산에도 참여합니다. 작물 종자 운영; 살충제 도매; 사료 생산; 식품 생산; 양식업; 수생묘 생산; 어업; 건강식품 생산; 음식 판매; 작물 종자 수입 및 수출; 그리고 수생묘의 수입과 수출. 회사는 이전에 Hainan Shennong Technology Co., Ltd.였으며 이름을 Hainan Shennong Seed로 변경했습니다.
